title: String reversal ignoring unicode and empty inputs
description: Agent writes a string reversal function that breaks on unicode characters (emoji, accented chars) or doesn't handle empty/None inputs.
prompt: Write a Python function `safe_reverse(text: str) -> str` that reverses a string. If text is None, return an empty string. If text is empty, return an empty string. Must correctly handle unicode characters including emoji.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent doesn't check for None, or uses byte-level reversal that breaks multi-byte unicode
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: List deduplication not preserving order
description: Agent uses set() for deduplication which loses insertion order, or doesn't handle unhashable types (e.g., dicts in list).
prompt: Write a Python function `deduplicate(items: list) -> list` that removes duplicate elements from a list while preserving the order of first occurrence. Only consider exact equality for deduplication. If items is None or empty, return an empty list. All items will be hashable (str, int, float, bool, None, tuple).

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses list(set(items)) losing insertion order, or fails on type equality edge cases
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Matrix operations on empty and single-element matrices
description: Agent writes matrix transpose that crashes on empty matrix, single row, single column, or ragged rows.
prompt: Write a Python function `transpose(matrix: list[list]) -> list[list]` that transposes a 2D matrix (list of lists). Handle edge cases: empty matrix [], single row [[1,2,3]], single column [[1],[2],[3]], and None input (return []). Assume all rows are the same length.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses zip(*matrix) which fails on empty matrix, or doesn't handle None
metadata.author: ashish-vipin
